subject.title: fix(slack): time out stalled external file uploads

question: Should OpenClaw support PlatformMessageNotDispatchedError as a public plugin SDK contract that allows channel adapters to declare a failed send safe for durable replay?
rationale: The class is technically narrow, but it delegates duplicate-delivery safety to external plugin code and creates a lasting compatibility and trust contract that automation cannot accept for maintainers.

options.title: Accept narrow public contract
options.body: Keep the class public only for adapter-owned failures before any recipient-visible or finalization-capable call, then require exact-head validation.

options.title: Keep replay authority internal
options.body: Remove the SDK export and preserve a Slack/core-private signal until maintainers design a broader plugin replay contract.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the class public only for adapter-owned failures before any recipient-visible or finalization-capable call, then require exact-head validation.
